name: California Tahoe Conservancy Grants
summary: Rolling state grants for land acquisition, planning, implementation and monitoring that protect and restore natural lands in the California side of the Lake Tahoe Basin. Applicants submit a short pre-application, then a full application if invited.

geography.label: California side of the Lake Tahoe Basin

status.quote: The Conservancy awards most of its grants on a rolling basis. With no formal solicitation, you can apply for funding at any time.

applicant_types.quote: Local public agencies including cities, counties, special districts, and joint powers authorities; state agencies; federal agencies; and the Tahoe Transportation District. Federally recognized Native American tribes. Nonprofit organizations registered to do business in California

geography.quote: The Conservancy funds a wide variety of projects on the California side of the Basin

access.quote: The Conservancy awards most of its grants on a rolling basis. With no formal solicitation, you can apply for funding at any time.

window.quote: The Conservancy awards most of its grants on a rolling basis. With no formal solicitation, you can apply for funding at any time.

amount.quote: Historically, Conservancy grant awards range between $50,000 and $5 million, with an average of $450,000.

effort.quote: Applying for funding involves a two-step process. Step 1: Submit a short pre-application.
The Conservancy will select pre-applications to move forward and will invite the selected applicants to submit full applications.
